title: Burrito bowl with cilantro-lime rice

items: 2 chipotle peppers in adobo, plus 1 Tbsp of the sauce
1½ cups corn (frozen and thawed, or canned and drained)
¼ cup finely diced red onion
1 cup shredded Monterey Jack or cheddar

steps: Blend the chipotles, adobo sauce, garlic, 2 Tbsp oil, cumin and salt until smooth. Rub it all over the chicken and let it sit while you start the rice, or up to 1 hr in the fridge.
Bring the rice, 2¼ cups water and 1 tsp salt to a boil in the saucepan over high heat. Cover, turn to low and cook 15 min. Rest off the heat, covered, 10 min.

Heat the remaining 1 Tbsp oil in the skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 5–7 min per side, until charred in spots and it reads 165°F in the thickest part. Rest 5 min, then chop into bite-size pieces.
Stir the corn, red onion, cilantro, lime juice and salt together for the salsa.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in the lime zest, lime juice and cilantro.
Warm the beans in a small pot over medium heat or in the microwave for 2 min.
Build each bowl with rice, beans, chicken and corn salsa. Top with romaine, cheese, sour cream and guacamole.
tips: Grill the chicken over medium-high heat instead, 5–6 min per side, to 165°F.
Freeze the leftover chipotles in a zip-top bag. They keep 3 months.
For lunches, pack the rice, beans, chicken and salsa together and add the cold toppings after reheating.
storage: Fridge up to 4 days, with the cold toppings kept separate. Cool the rice within 2 hr. Reheat rice, beans and chicken covered in the microwave 2–3 min, until hot. Guacamole browns within a day.
